title: Kaisay Sulagti Rait Pay Soya
body:
Kaisai sulgti rait pay soya mera Asghar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh soach kay roti rahi (x2) baysheer ki maadar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhartee thi wo aahain
Lay aaye hoon paani main kahan hai tu biraadar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Shimar kay dar sai
Lehra ta howa khanjar aya jo sitamghar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ko bula day
Aik zakam laga kaari Akbar kay jigar paar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Koyi day day sahara
Ghoray pay charhoon kaisay, Qasim hai na Akbar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam ta arash pai
Jab Sibt-e-Payamber pai, chala Shimar ka khanjar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra ki kaali ko
Naizay say utari jab, bay deen nay chadar.
